lead: Heart-healthy beets you can drink. Beetroot and hibiscus — two of nature's best-studied ingredients for healthy blood pressure — in a lightly apple-sweet scoop. Mix it into water for circulation, stamina and cardiovascular support.
note: 30 servings · 3.44 oz (97.5 g) · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Beetroot meets hibiscus
science.text: Beetroot is loaded with dietary nitrates that convert into nitric oxide to relax blood vessels — and hibiscus is one of the most-studied botanicals for supporting healthy blood pressure. We blend 1,375 mg of beetroot with 1,000 mg of hibiscus and a touch of apple, so you get two heart-friendly ingredients in one easy-drinking scoop.

format.title: Beets you'll actually drink
format.text: No juicing, no chalky pills. A lightly apple-sweet scoop that mixes into water in seconds — heart support that tastes good enough to keep up every day.
list: — 1 scoop (3.25 g) = 1,375 mg beetroot + 1,000 mg hibiscus

absorb.title: Two ways to support your pressure
absorb.lead: Beetroot's nitrates relax blood vessels via nitric oxide, while hibiscus adds its own well-studied blood-pressure support — together, more than either alone.

items.name: Beet Root Powder
items.text: A rich source of dietary nitrates that convert into nitric oxide to relax blood vessels and support circulation.

items.name: Hibiscus Powder
items.text: One of the most-studied botanicals for healthy blood pressure, with a tart flavour and antioxidant polyphenols.

items.name: Apple Juice Powder
items.text: A naturally sweet apple powder that rounds out the flavour — easy-drinking and lightly sweet, with no added sugar.

facts.side_text: 1,375 mg beetroot, 1,000 mg hibiscus and 500 mg apple juice powder, sweetened with stevia — no added sugar. Made in the USA — 97.5 g, 30 servings.
facts.warning: If you take blood-pressure medication, are pregnant or nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use. Beetroot may turn urine or stools pink — this is harmless.

steps.title: One scoop in water
steps.text: Mix 1 scoop (3.25 g) into 8–10 oz of cold water and stir or shake until dissolved.

steps.title: ~30 min before exercise
steps.text: For a circulation and stamina boost, drink it about 30 minutes before training.

steps.title: Or daily for blood pressure
steps.text: For everyday cardiovascular support, have it at the same time each day.

items.q: How is this different from the beetroot capsules?
items.a: Same heart-healthy beetroot, in a drinkable powder — plus 1,000 mg of hibiscus for extra blood-pressure support and a pleasant, lightly sweet taste.

items.q: Why beetroot and hibiscus for blood pressure?
items.a: Beetroot's nitrates relax blood vessels via nitric oxide, and hibiscus is one of the most-studied botanicals for supporting healthy blood pressure — together they cover two pathways.
Mildly tart from the hibiscus and lightly sweet from apple and stevia — far more pleasant than plain beet juice.

items.q: Will it change my urine colour?
items.a: It can turn urine or stools pink or red — that's a harmless effect of beetroot pigments, not a cause for concern.
